purpose: Leakage-controlled historical feature, eligibility and event-level split layer built from the frozen v3 master panel; no model fitted.
reference_rule: all rolling features end at liquidity_reference_session, which is one benchmark session before entry_session
boundary_rule: purge an entire source event from the earlier split if entry_session or exit_session is on or after the next split start
missing_policy: retain all rows and NA values; no fill, interpolation, winsorization, clipping or row deletion
preprocessing_status: not fitted; scaling, imputation and winsorization remain pending and must be learned on training only
